verses.1: Write on the message of the church in Ephesus: “This is what the one who rules over the seven stars says: He who walks among the seven golden lamps.”
verses.2: I know your efforts, as well as your patience and perseverance. I also know that you refuse to harm the wicked. You also challenged those who claimed to be messengers, and you realized that they were not true messengers at all. You found them to be deceivers.
verses.3: And you have patience. You’ve endured because of my name, and you haven’t given up.
verses.4: But I know that you first lost your love.
verses.5: So, I ask where you have gone? May you repent and begin to do good deeds again. But if not, then I will come to you, and I will remove your chains from that place, unless you repent.
verses.6: But you do hate the work of the Nicollaites; I also hate it.
verses.7: He who has those ears will hear what the Spirit says in the churches. To the one who wins, I will give to eat from the tree of life; that is, from the divine realm itself.
verses.8: And write to the messenger from the church in Syria: “This is what the first and the last said. He who became dead and came back to life.”
verses.9: Do you know about his suffering and poverty? Yet he’s still rich. He also knows that the Jews speak ill of him. But in reality, he isn’t such a bad person at all; he’s actually one of Satan’s followers.
verses.10: Do not fear what you will suffer. Be prepared that the Devil will throw you into prison so that you can be tested. You will suffer for ten days. Be faithful until your death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.11: He who has those things that I am about to speak of, says what the Spirit says in the assemblies. The one who wins will not be wronged after his second death.
verses.12: And write to the messenger from the church in Pergamum: “This is what he says who possesses the strength of both legs.”
verses.13: I know where you reside, in the place where Satan dwells. You also hold my name. I will not deny my faith even on those days of Antipas. He is my witness, my believer. He has gone before you, to the place where Satan dwells.
verses.14: But I have a few things to say regarding you. You keep teaching the teachings of Balak. He taught Balak to do evil deeds before the children of Israel’s eyes, to eat in places where it’s not allowed, and to engage in prostitution.
verses.15: In the same way, you also keep teaching the teachings of Nikolaos.
verses.16: Let us then be enlightened. If not, I will come to you quickly, and I will fight against them through the opening in my mouth.
verses.17: He who has those ears will hear what the Spirit says in the assemblies. To the one who wins, I will give the secret gift; I will also give him a white scroll. On this scroll, there will be written a new name, which no one knows, except for the one who receives it.
verses.18: And write also to the messenger of the church in Thyatira: “These things I say, son of God, who has eyes like flames of fire, and whose feet are like copper wires.”
verses.19: You know what your duties are, as well as your love, faith, devotion, and patience. Your actions are far more noble than those of others.
verses.20: But I know that you have abandoned your wife, Jezabel. She herself said that she would be a prophetess. And she also teaches and tempts our slaves to commit prostitution and eat in places where it’s forbidden.
verses.21: And I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent from her prostitution.
verses.22: I throw her into the basket. Those who sin with her will be subjected to great suffering, if they do not repent from their actions.
verses.23: And her children will also be destroyed in death. And all the churches will know that I am the one who holds the keys of life and death. I will give each of you according to your deeds.
verses.24: But to the rest of those who are in Thυατείρ, I say that those who do not possess this knowledge, those who have not understood the depths of Satan’s schemes, I will not impose any further burden upon you.
verses.25: In addition, keep what you have saved until I come back.
verses.26: And he who wins and perseveres until the end will give him authority over the nations.
verses.27: And they are stored in iron boxes, just like the pottery items are stored there.
verses.28: As I was told by my father, I will give him the star that is his sign.
verses.29: The one who has those ears will hear what the Spirit says in the churches.
